issueSummary: High-pressure water pipe leak under rinse basin pooling onto chemical storage floor
reportedLocation: Science Complex B, Room 104 Bio-Organic Chemistry Lab
imageObservations: Photo shows water spraying against cabinet wall under sink P-104 and pooling near electrical baseboard conduit.
studentProvidedFacts: Water spraying continuously under the secondary wash basin
Pool is spreading towards chemical cabinet 3
visualObservations: Ruptured PEX compression fitting visible near shutoff valve
Water pool approximately 3 inches from floor electrical junction box
aiInferences: Extreme safety hazard: high-pressure liquid near ground-level power conduit
Requires immediate emergency isolation valve shutdown

statusHistory.notes: Emergency shutoff valve isolated in hallway riser 4. Replacement brass valve kit ordered for installation.

notesThread.author: Robert Santos (Plumbing Dept)
notesThread.message: Water shutoff verified safe. Electrician inspected adjacent outlet and certified dry. Pipe replacement underway.

safetyWarning: Water accumulation within 1 meter of 120V electrical conduit. Power breaker isolated by facilities.
